usedFor: ShareFile holds clients and files, and HubSpot receives them as contacts, deals or company updates through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in ShareFile, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new client becomes a HubSpot contact, and the action returns the created record.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so map the client's email into it.
